programs.title: First Man
programs.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: Oscar's Eye
programs.desc: Nine-year-old Oscar cannot speak.Because of this, he is rejected and bullied by his peers.However, he becomes friends with the owner of the workshop, Eric, with whom he shares a common passion - photography.

programs.title: BlacKkKlansman
programs.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programs.title: Insecure 3
programs.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.The girl, despite numerous humiliations and lack of self-confidence, tries to live her own way.Her best friend is self-absorbed lawyer Molly (Yvonne Orji).Ich relacja przechodzi jednak kryzys.Issa tries to overcome her weaknesses with varying degrees of success.He begins to question his role in the non-governmental organization where he works.He earns money as a driver.She's also trying to pick up the pieces after her breakup with Lawrence.Trying to save extra money, she stays with her former partner and childhood friend, Daniel, who is working on developing his musical career.Tymczasem Molly rozpoczyna nową pracę.She is surprised that she is not immediately considered a star in the new law firm.Odbija się to na jej poczuciu pewności siebie.The third season of a brilliant comedy series about the life of an insecure young African-American woman.The production tells the story of a generation of twenty-somethings lost in the world of today, their friendships, experiences, joys and problems.The originator of the series, its producer and the main actress is the talented Issa Rae (series "First").She gained fame through her website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel (over 200,000 followers and 20 million views).W pozostałe postacie wcielają się m.in.Yvonne Orji (series "Love That Girl!") and Lisa Joyce ("It's Never Too Late").The production was nominated for a Golden Globe.

programs.title: Insecure 3
programs.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.The girl, despite numerous humiliations and lack of self-confidence, tries to live her own way.Her best friend is self-absorbed lawyer Molly (Yvonne Orji).However, their relationship is going through a crisis.Issa tries to overcome her weaknesses with varying degrees of success.He begins to question his role in the non-governmental organization where he works.He earns money as a driver.She's also trying to pick up the pieces after her breakup with Lawrence.Trying to save extra money, she stays with her former partner and childhood friend, Daniel, who is working on developing his musical career.Meanwhile, Molly starts a new job.She is surprised that she is not immediately considered a star in the new law firm.This affects her self-confidence.The third season of a brilliant comedy series about the life of an insecure young African-American woman.The production tells the story of a generation of twenty-somethings lost in the world of today, their friendships, experiences, joys and problems.The originator of the series, its producer and the main actress is the talented Issa Rae (series "First").She gained fame through her website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel (over 200,000 followers and 20 million views).The other characters are played by, among others:Yvonne Orji (series "Love That Girl!") and Lisa Joyce ("It's Never Too Late").The production was nominated for a Golden Globe.

programs.title: The Last of Us 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since Ellie (Bella Ramsey) and Joel (Pedro Pascal)'s dangerous journey.They both still function in a world whose rules are dictated by a pandemic caused by cordyceps.At first it is easier for them because they live in the city of Jackson, where they have many friends.Gdy jednak mężczyznę dosięga zemsta Abby Anderson (Kaitlyn Dever), córki lekarza z Salt Lake City, i żołnierzy z jej oddziału - Wilków - Ellie nie ma innego wyjścia, jak opuścić miejscowość, by ją odnaleźć i odpłacić tym samym.She is accompanied on a dangerous expedition by her friend, Dina (Isabela Moner).

programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: The Order
programs.desc: 1983, Idaho.FBI agent Terry Husk (Jude Law) with the help of local policeman Jamie Bowen (Tye Sheridan) takes down a far-right terrorist group.The criminals are led by Bob Mathews (Nicholas Hoult), who, together with his men, commits daring robberies.Neo-Nazis intend to use the looted funds to start a revolution and overthrow the US government.They draw inspiration from the apocalyptic novel "The Turner Diaries" about race war.In 1984, they kill liberal journalist Alan Berg (Marc Maron).Finally, there is a bloody confrontation between law enforcement officers and bandits.Scenario based on facts.

programs.title: Berlin Nobody
programs.desc: American social psychologist Ben Monroe (Eric Bana) moves to Berlin after breaking up with his wife.He gained fame for his research on sects, including a religious group operating in the German capital, and is currently preparing to write another book on this subject.One day, his partner Nina (Sylvia Hoeks) and his old friend, policeman Max Aumann (Stephan Kampwirth), take him to a crime scene where it seems that several people have been ritually committed suicide.Soon, Ben is visited by his 16-year-old daughter, Mazzy (Sadie Sink).She is seduced by a local boy, Martin (Jonas Dassler).He tells her that he is involved in the activities of a pro-ecological non-governmental organization run by the charismatic Hilma (Sophie Rois).The girl allows herself to be drawn into this group, unaware that it is a sect that has chosen her as a victim.When Ben discovers how much danger Mazzy is in, he races against time to save her.The film's script is based on the 2015 novel by Nicholas Hogg."Tokyo", but the setting was moved to Berlin.

programs.title: Assassin's Creed
programs.desc: Recidivist Callum Lynch sentenced to death is not executed.After a fake execution, he ends up in a secret laboratory.There he meets Rikkin and his daughter Sofia.Scientists have a mysterious device that allows them to access the records of ancestors' actions stored in their genes.The criminal is to connect with the consciousness of Aguilar from Spain, who lived during the Great Inquisition and obtained the Apple of Eden, which provides control over emotions.By using this item, you can supposedly eliminate aggression in people.The daredevil travels to the Middle Ages.He discovers that he is a descendant of a member of the Assassin secret society.Over time, he learns what a big mistake he made when he trusted Sofia and her father.

programs.title: One to One: John \u0026 Yoko
programs.desc: The story of a famous couple of artists, focusing on the One to One charity concert that took place at Madison Square Garden on August 30, 1972.From 1971, John Lennon and Yoko Ono lived in New York, in Greenwich Village, for 18 months.Their then apartment was reconstructed for the film.Private film, photo and music archives of artists and friends were also used, as well as FBI tapes to show their fate and the company they kept in: from Allen Ginsberg to Jerry Rubin and activist AJ Weberman.
